scripts.build: tsc && mkdir -p dist/css dist/src && sed -e 's#./src/styles/tailwind/output.css#./css/output.css#' -e 's#./src/styles/css/style.css#./css/style.css#' -e 's#./dist/script.js#./script.js#' index.html > dist/index.html && cp src/styles/css/style.css dist/css/ && cp src/currency.json dist/src/ && cp favicon.ico dist/ && npx @tailwindcss/cli -i ./src/styles/tailwind/input.css -o ./dist/css/output.css --minify
